transport.topologySemantics: NWB junction topology; A/N routes and international/numeric co-designations sharing one unambiguous wegnummer are one physical corridor, not additive capacity. A source section may support consecutive series edges at a municipal junction; those edge ceilings are not parallel capacity and must never be summed as independent corridors.
transport.auditedLifelines: OVapi GTFS, BGT/NWB and BRT TOP10NL transport geometry plus municipality/operator identity evidence; observed human-readable status remains context-only without issue/expiry time; generalized scenario capacity
transport.auditedRoadAliases: RWS NWB wegnummer-based physical-corridor normalization plus municipality-audited signed-name corrections and non-additive route-name fragments; aliases retain source provenance and never add capacity
transport.auditedSharedSections: Repeated NWB section provenance is permitted only for audited consecutive series edges; it is never independent or additive corridor capacity.
